theme.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

[data-theme=\"moneytrees\"].dark body.background-image: radial-gradient(at 18% 22%, hsl(263 70% 60% / 0.28) 0px, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 82% 12%, hsl(189 94% 55% / 0.22) 0px, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 50% 90%, hsl(43 96% 56% / 0.18) 0px, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(at 78% 55%, hsl(263 70% 60% / 0.16) 0px, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 12% 70%, hsl(189 94% 55% / 0.12) 0px, transparent 55%)

[data-theme=\"moneytrees\"]:not(.dark) b.background-image: radial-gradient(at 18% 22%, hsl(263 70% 70% / 0.22) 0px, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 82% 12%, hsl(189 94% 65% / 0.18) 0px, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 50% 90%, hsl(43 96% 65% / 0.18) 0px, transparent 60%)
